camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainCcActivityLog --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2018-12-10T21:00:00Z' --PageSize 30 --DomainName 'example.com' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2018-12-10T20:00:00Z' --Value '1.2.3.4' --TriggerObject IP --RuleName test2
description_en: Queries log entries of rate limiting
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainCcActivityLog查询频次控制规则拦截日志
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-cc-activity-log --domain-name example.com --start-time 2018-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2018-12-10T21:00:00Z --trigger-object IP --value 1.2.3.4 --rule-name test2 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainCcActivityLog

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,).

If you do not specify this parameter, data of all accelerated domain names under your account is queried
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The minimum time granularity of data collection is 5 minutes.

If you leave this parameter empty, the data collected over the last 24 hours is queried
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

最小数据粒度为5分钟。

若该参数为空，默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The trigger of rate limiting by which you want to query data.

If you leave this parameter empty, all events that triggered rate limiting are queried
parameters.help_zh:
触发对象。

若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: trigger_object

parameters.help_en:
The value of the trigger.

If you leave this parameter empty, all events recorded for the trigger are queried
parameters.help_zh:
触发对象值

若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en:
A custom rule name. Valid values:

default_normal: rule for the normal mode

default_attack: rule for the emergency mode

If you leave this parameter empty, events that triggered rate limiting based on all rules are queried
parameters.help_zh:
自定义规则名。取值：
正常模式规则：default_normal。
紧急模式规则：default_attack。

若该参数为空，则查询所有拦截事件
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

ActivityLog.description_en: The list of rate limiting logs

RuleName.description_en: The name of the rule based on which rate limiting was triggered

TimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp of the data returned

Ttl.description_en: The period of time during which rate limiting remains effective

Value.description_en: The value of the trigger for rate limiting

PageIndex.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
